Battle of Ap Gu.question: At 15:55 the first element of the 1st Battalion, 16th _____, except C Company, touched down at LZ George under VC sniper fire and occupied positions to the west and northwest of the 1/26th Infantry
Battle of Ap Gu.fact: At 15:55 the first element of the 1st Battalion, 16th Infantry Regiment, except C Company, touched down at LZ George under VC sniper fire and occupied positions to the west and northwest of the 1/26th Infantry.
